DO $$
DECLARE
    constraint_record RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR constraint_record IN
        SELECT constraint_name
        FROM information_schema.table_constraints
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'human_handoff_tasks'
          AND constraint_type = 'CHECK'
    LOOP
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM pg_constraint constraint_item
            INNER JOIN pg_class relation
                ON relation.oid = constraint_item.conrelid
            WHERE relation.relname = 'human_handoff_tasks'
              AND constraint_item.conname =
                  constraint_record.constraint_name
              AND (
                    pg_get_constraintdef(
                        constraint_item.oid
                    ) ILIKE '%source_type%'

                    OR pg_get_constraintdef(
                        constraint_item.oid
                    ) ILIKE '%task_type%'
                  )
        ) THEN
            EXECUTE FORMAT(
                'ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks DROP CONSTRAINT %I',
                constraint_record.constraint_name
            );
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END
$$;

ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
    ADD CONSTRAINT human_handoff_tasks_source_type_check
    CHECK (
        source_type IN (
            'appointment_confirmation',
            'disruption_case',
            'waitlist_offer',
            'appointment',
            'medication_case',
            'insurance_case',
            'feedback_case',
            'knowledge_query',
            'conversation_message',
            'manual'
        )
    );

ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
    ADD CONSTRAINT human_handoff_tasks_task_type_check
    CHECK (
        task_type IN (
            'confirmation_no_response',
            'reschedule_request',
            'calendar_sync_issue',
            'medical_review',
            'complaint',
            'insurance_support',
            'information_request',
            'conversation_handoff',
            'manual_followup'
        )
    );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tool_execution_logs (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    session_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES conversation_sessions(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    input_message_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES conversation_messages(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    tool_action TEXT NOT NULL,

    target_workflow_number INTEGER,
    target_workflow_name TEXT,

    endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
    http_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'POST'
        CHECK (
            http_method IN (
                'GET',
                'POST',
                'PUT',
                'PATCH',
                'DELETE'
            )
        ),

    request_payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'pending',
                'running',
                'succeeded',
                'failed',
                'skipped',
                'blocked'
            )
        ),

    idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    duration_ms INTEGER
        CHECK (
            duration_ms IS NULL
            OR duration_ms >= 0
        ),

    http_status INTEGER,

    response_payload JSONB,

    error_type TEXT,
    error_message TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tool_execution_message
    ON tool_execution_logs(
        input_message_id,
        created_at DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tool_execution_session
    ON tool_execution_logs(
        session_id,
        created_at DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tool_execution_active
    ON tool_execution_logs(
        status,
        created_at
    )
    WHERE status IN (
        'pending',
        'running',
        'failed'
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tool_execution_action
    ON tool_execution_logs(
        tool_action,
        created_at DESC
    );

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار ثبت اجرای ابزارها و ارجاع مکالمه به انسان ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Workflow جدول `tool_execution_logs` را ایجاد می‌کند.

هر فراخوانی ابزار با Payload، وضعیت، تعداد تلاش، نتیجه و خطا ثبت می‌شود.

همچنین `conversation_message` و `conversation_handoff` به ساختار ارجاع انسانی افزوده می‌شوند.
